decisions.reason: As a core garage door operator line with multiple models, its option value remains high and keeping it costs little, so uncertainty has not resolved negatively enough to abandon.
The remote-control operator overlaps with the core operator line A and has not shown distinct value after four years, so the option can be abandoned to free resources.
The glazed insulated industrial sectional door offers clear energy-efficiency benefits that align with market and regulatory trends, so its option remains worth keeping.
The non-insulated glazed industrial sectional door is largely superseded by the insulated E, and its option value has likely resolved negatively, making it a candidate for withdrawal.
